arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# R1: letters matcher
print('=== R1: letters matcher ===')
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello')
print('letters hello:', r)
r2 = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello123')
print('letters hello123:', r2)

# R2: __contains__ on Result
print('\n=== R2: __contains__ ===')
r = parse.parse('Name = {name}', 'Name = Alice')
print('Alice in result:', 'Alice' in r)
print('Bob in result:', 'Bob' in r)
print('name in result:', 'name' in r)

# R3: malformed braces
print('\n=== R3: malformed braces ===')
try:
    parse.compile('{unclosed')
    print('ERROR: should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Unclosed brace raises ValueError:', str(e)[:50])

# R4: FixedTzOffset
print('\n=== R4: FixedTzOffset ===')
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
tz = parse.FixedTzOffset('test', -5*60 - 30)  # -530 format
dt = datetime(2023, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz)
print('FixedTzOffset works:', dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z'))

# R5: Fortran floats
print('\n=== R5: Fortran floats ===')
r = parse.parse('{:f}', '12.0')
print('Plain float:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:f}', '-12.1')
print('Neg float:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:.2f}', '3.14159')
print('With precision:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:8.5f}', '.31415')
print('Precision fail (.31415):', r)

# R6: hex/binary/octal
print('\n=== R6: hex/binary/octal ===')
r = parse.parse('{:x}', 'ff')
print('Hex ff:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:b}', '1010')
print('Binary 1010:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:o}', '77')
print('Octal 77:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:d}', '-42')
print('Signed int:', r)

# R7: findall case_sensitive
print('\n=== R7: findall case_sensitive ===')
result = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello WORLD hello', case_sensitive=False)
print('findall case-insensitive:', [m.fixed[0] for m in result])
result2 = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello WORLD hello', case_sensitive=True)
print('findall case-sensitive:', [m.fixed[0] for m in result2])

# R8: alignment
print('\n=== R8: alignment ===')
r = parse.parse('{:<10}', 'hello world')
print('Left aligned:', repr(r.fixed[0]))

# R9: slice access
print('\n=== R9: slice access ===')
r = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
print('Slice [0:2]:', r[0:2])
print('Slice [::]:', r[::])
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
